Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so only the first channel of a polyphonic cable reaches the firmware.

comment: The panel prints its labels in lower case: param, clock, in, out, A, B and the numbers 1 to 4. The USB jack is a Rack switch parameter and so can be mapped with VCV MIDI-MAP or Stoermelder MIDI-CAT to move a grid between modules from a controller. The clock knob's range, 2 seconds to 47ms, and the trigger level of 8V come from the maker's manual in docs/content/modules/whitewhale.md and docs/content/general/voltage.md. The Switch Firmware menu offers the Kria alternate firmware as well as the standard one.
